summary: This YAML file defines a GitLab CI/CD pipeline configuration for running code quality and testing tools. It sets up a reusable Docker environment with Dagger (a containerized task runner), then defines four separate jobs (lint, format, mypy, and ruff) that each inherit that environment and run different code checks on the source code.

explanations.4: This starts a Docker-in-Docker service, allowing the pipeline to run Docker commands inside a Docker container. The ${DOCKER_VERSION} is a variable placeholder that gets replaced with an actual version number.
explanations.8: This tells the .dagger configuration to reuse all the settings from .docker (the Docker setup), so it inherits the image and services without repeating them.
explanations.11: This downloads and installs Dagger directly into the container's /usr/local/bin directory so it's available as a command-line tool for the subsequent jobs.
explanations.15: This runs Dagger with a specific configuration pointing to the src directory and .config file, then executes the 'lint' task defined in Dagger's configuration.
